text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our trial against Mejiro McQueen begins.
These 2,400 meters of turf
will determine
whether I'm fit to be Satono Diamond's
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(She's kept up so far, but it's still early.
2,400 meters is a
considerable
distance—the true test is yet to come.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(We're almost at the final stretch! Soon,
the true contest will
be...gin?!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? A final spurt already?! She broke
ahead of me!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An impressive burst of speed. But!

Haaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Oh my... your inexperience is showing.
That momentum of yours
won't last! This
match is settled, Satono!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nnnghaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen blitzes past Satono
Diamond, and from then on, the
gap only
widens—all the way until the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono... may I ask what your intentions
were? Why choose such a
losing strategy?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(She's... not looking at me. It's like she
can't even hear my voice.
And...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(There isn't a hint of regret in her eyes.
She looks satisfied... like she
gave it her
all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Ah. I believe I understand.)

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Very well, let's move on to the verdict.
There was a significant gap
toward the end
of the race... but please give us your
opinion,
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Before I announce my decision, there is
something I wish to confirm
first. Satono...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You weren't aiming to win today, were
you? I suspect you didn't do
any
2,400-meter training either.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Not aiming to win? No training? What do
you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's reputation isn't for
nothing. She's seen through
everything,
just from Satono Diamond's running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: May I ask you two to explain?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course. You see, we...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Reduce my training? And to top it
off, we're not prioritizing the
trial? What
do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we don't pass, my family won't give us
their approval! We have to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's dream is to win a G1
race. Given her current
physique, it's too
dangerous to train her for 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her first races will be at the junior level,
and the longest junior G1 is
2,000 meters.
I can't ignore that to focus on this
trial—not if I call
myself a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Are you... saying I shouldn't even try?
Because I might injure myself?
But I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Our number one goal... is achieving our
dream. Not passing today's
trial.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So we only trained the qualities I need
right now. Even if you might
not like it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is the path I must take. I'll make our
dream—our family's dearest
wish—come
true. Trainer and I were brought together
for this
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A 2,000-meter G1 demands speed. I may
not have the all-around
ability to win at
2,400 meters yet, but this speed will be
key in all my
future G1s.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is what we wanted to show you. We've
charted a course towards
our dream—one
that doesn't take unnecessary risks. Today,
you saw
how far we've come!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Dia... You...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see. That certainly explains it. I had
thought your final spurt was too
hasty, but
you were treating it like a 2,000-meter
finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then there was the look in your eyes when
you lost. It reminded me of
my past self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When I took part in the Classics,
everyone competed with
burning passion.
You could tell each of us was chasing
far-fetched
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Others desperately chased the Triple
Crown. But as a member of the
Mejiro
family, I had a different priority—the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our racing careers are as fleeting as youth
itself, yet there are still
those who choose
to devote their careers to their chosen
path... That
same resolve made me who I
am today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Only those who chase their dreams with
wholehearted dedication may
achieve
them, even if they must abandon all else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen smiles at us like an
affectionate mother.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yes, I see... My goodness, it... it all
makes sense now...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we haven't been dedicated enough
to our dream. We haven't
won a G1 race
because we've been too focused on
fundamentals and
reputation.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we need to change. My
daughter has broken jinxes all
her life. If
her instincts tell her this is right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's parents look at each
other. They nod slowly, and
then...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. From now on, we entrust Dia to
you. She is our family's most
brilliant gem...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
...And our beloved daughter. We shall
have faith in you as you have
in each
other.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! We did it, Trainer! We really did it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's make our dream come true! Nobody's
ever broken my family's
jinx, but I know we
can, as long as we work together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've managed to pass the Satono
family's trial and gain their
approval. But
this is only the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're still a long way from achieving Satono Diamond's dream—our dream. But one day, she'll win a G1 race and shine at the top of the racing world.
